correctness.rationale: From the published finite-ring stationary gap weights w0=1,w1=1-p,w_g=(1-p)²/q for g>=2, constructed the 3x3 nonnegative primitive transfer T and renewal generating function U(z)=p(z+(1-p)z²+((1-p)²/q)z³/(1-z)). Perron root z0 solves U(z0)=1; the Palm renewal density is rho=1/[z0 U’(z0)]. The connected two-point coefficient is rho times non-Perron residues of (1-z)/P(z), P=1-(1+p)z+p²z²+p(a-b)z³. Exact cubic discriminant = -p(1-p)²R_p(q)/q² with negative-leading, positive-constant quadratic R yields one q_c(p)∈(0,1-p). Nonreal non-Perron pole pair below gives genuine sign oscillations; at coalescing double positive root the Laurent coefficient is positive and yields r*kappa^r; above the smallest positive non-Perron pole dominates a negative larger-modulus third root or quadratic degeneracy, with positive residue. Square-root Puiseux expansion gives theta~sqrt(q_c-q). The two-neighbour analogue has strictly positive discriminant. Independent symbolic expansion confirmed the discriminant, and at p=1/2,q=1/5 factored P=-(3z-2)(z²+4)/8 with roots 2/3,±2i; low-lag correlations match 1/100 and -7/300. Finite ring checks do not prove thermodynamic convergence; primitivity and renewal theorem do.
